title_en: Stories of Modern China (12/20): A Village of Kiwis
note_en: The character 种 is two different words: as a verb it's zhòng "plant, grow" (家家户户都种玉米 "every household grew corn"), and as a measure word it's zhǒng "kind, type" (一种水果 "a single kind of fruit"). English has similar pairs spelled alike but pronounced differently, like "to record" vs. "a record"; in Chinese, the tone and the grammar around the character tell you which one it is.
